name: Crypto stress
summary: Binance restoring withdrawals in phases after $6.3bn theft; Bitcoin 11% below its high
state: Binance began phased restoration of withdrawals on 1 Nov after about $6.3bn was stolen in late October, which the FBI attributed to North Korea; on 2 Nov it said it had replaced about 95% of stolen assets and showed full reserves for ten major assets (Help Net Security). Bitcoin was near $76,700 on 2 Nov, 11% below its high, so the Watch status rests on the exchange's continuing stress.
for_you: Binance customers may still face delays on some withdrawals. Any shortfall in reserves would matter most for those holding funds on the exchange.
rubric_hit: Top-10 exchange under stress (Binance phased withdrawals) = Watch; BTC drawdown 11% < 25%
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: Help Net Security — FBI pins $6.3 billion Binance heist on North Korea
CNBC — Binance resumes withdrawals following $6.3 billion hack

why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
